model_a.notes: Both sessions were separate from the project context and received only their rendered prompt; the adjudication session additionally received the blind batch file.

model_b.notes: This model ran in the session that authored the v3 contract, prompts, topology catalogue, and pipeline, and that produced the Frozen Test v2 failure taxonomy. Its generation of Batch B therefore breaks the independence rule and is disclosed in benchmarks/frozen_test_v3/generation_provenance.json. Its adjudication of Batch A satisfies the cross-review rule, since it did not generate Batch A, but it judged against a specification it had itself written.

roles_summary: Model A generated Batch A and adjudicated blind Batch B; Model B generated Batch B and adjudicated blind Batch A.
